howto.name: Upload audio files
howto.text: Drop 2 or more audio files (MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC, AAC). Maximum 200 MB per file.

howto.name: Reorder if needed
howto.text: Drag thumbnails to set the concatenation order.

howto.name: Download the merged audio
howto.text: FFmpeg concatenates the files into one output. Format defaults to the first input's format.

faq.q: What if my files have different sample rates?
faq.a: FFmpeg resamples to a common rate (usually 44.1 kHz) automatically. There may be a tiny re-encoding loss; for lossless concatenation use FLAC inputs.
No — files are concatenated seamlessly. To add silence, prepare it as a separate file with the same format and insert it in the order.
Practical limit is whatever fits inside the 500 MB output. Hours of MP3 at moderate bitrate is fine.
